svg.text: JAX/XLA SHARDY (MLIR) VS. GSPMD: HIERARCHICAL DEVICE MESH & ICI-VS-DCN PARALLELISM
XLA Shardy Priority Propagation + 3D Torus ICI/DCN Mesh Lifts MoE MFU to 59.6%
2,048-Chip 400B-A45B MoE (4x512 Slices): Tier 1 TP/FSDP on DCN (15.8% MFU) vs. Tier 3 GSPMD (48.2%) vs. Tier 4 Shardy (59.6%)
⛔ Tier 1–3 Traps: DCN AllGather & GSPMD Reshards
1. Stretching TP or FSDP Across Inter-Slice DCN (15.8% MFU):
• `TP` & `FSDP` run 2–4 collectives per layer (256x/step); placing
them on 100G DCN instead of 1.2T ICI exposes 68.5% comm stalls!
2. 1D Flat FSDP Ring Over a 3D Torus Slice (38.4% MFU):
• Ignores orthogonal X/Y/Z torus axes, creating 512-hop ring latency
and activation memory exhaustion on long sequences
3. Legacy GSPMD Sharding Conflicts on MoE Branches (38GB Waste):
• Flat HLO propagation inserts redundant Reshard/All-to-All copies
Production Failure Impact (2,048-Chip 4-Slice MoE Run):
• Sustained MFU: 15.8% (Tier 1) | 48.2% (Tier 3 Legacy GSPMD)
• Redundant Reshard Traffic: 148 GB/step (T1) | 38 GB/step (T3)
• Monthly 2,048-Chip Training TCO: $3,920,000 / month
🏆 Tier 4: XLA Shardy + 3D ICI/DCN Mesh + shard_map
1. Strict Physical-to-Logical Axis Mapping (6.4% Exposed Comm):
• `TP=8` on intra-host/Z-axis ICI; `FSDP=64 / EP=64` on 2D X×Y
3D Torus ICI; outer `DP=4` strictly on inter-slice DCN
2. XLA `Shardy` (MLIR) Priority Propagation & Sub-Axis Splitting:
• Resolves Attention (`DPxFSDP`) to MoE (`EPxTP`) transitions with
`0.0 GB` redundant reshards (+11.4 pts MFU over legacy GSPMD)
3. `shard_map` + Pallas Ring-Attention / Async All-to-All:
• Hand-schedules explicit collective-permute overlap (`59.6%` MFU)
Tier 4 Verified Production Benchmarks:
• Sustained Cluster MFU: 59.6% (+11.4 pts vs. Legacy GSPMD)
• Exposed Collective Overhead: 6.4% | Redundant Reshard: 0.0 GB
• Monthly Total TCO: $1,480,000 / mo (-62.2% savings vs. Tier 1)
